title: Transferring an analysis of human brain organization to language models
abstract: arXiv:2611.24626v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: During human cortical development, functional systems become increasingly differentiated. We asked whether improved reasoning in language models involves a comparable regional reorganization. Applying diffusion-map embedding, used to characterize cortical organization, to matched base and reasoning-trained models from three families, we found broadly preserved gradient profiles with localized changes within a contiguous layer span. Grafting weights from these spans into instruction-tuned hosts improved mathematical reasoning on average, with gains rising with region overlap, while retaining more previously solved problems than grafts elsewhere. Across training, the span formed gradually during the early rise in performance, and grafts from intermediate stages helped. translated_title: 将人类大脑组织结构分析迁移至语言模型
translated_abstract: 在人类大脑皮层发育过程中，功能系统逐渐分化。我们提出疑问：语言模型推理能力的提升是否涉及类似的区域性重组。我们将通常用于刻画皮层组织结构的扩散映射嵌入方法，应用于来自三个模型家族的相互匹配的基座模型与经推理训练的模型，发现整体梯度轮廓大体保持不变，但在一段连续的层跨度内存在局部变化。将这些跨度区域的权重嫁接到指令微调的宿主模型中，平均而言提升了数学推理能力，且增益随区域重叠度的增加而上升，同时比在其他位置进行嫁接保留了更多先前已成功解决的问题。在整个训练过程中，该跨度在性能早期上升阶段逐渐形成，来自中间训练阶段的嫁接同样有效。嫁接使大多数宿主模型的行为部分向其供体模型偏移，有时甚至在供体模型未能解决的问题上取得改进；同一分析还在一个（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该研究将刻画人类皮层组织的扩散映射方法应用于语言模型，发现推理训练使模型在一段连续层跨度内发生局部重组，将该区域的权重嫁接到其他模型中可提升其数学推理能力。
en_tdlr: By applying diffusion-map embedding—used to characterize human cortical organization—to language models, the authors identify a contiguous layer span that locally reorganizes during reasoning training, and grafting weights from this span into instruction-tuned hosts improves mathematical reasoning.
